user.title: assist-live server and fallback engines
user.description: The project is experimental. Select standard fallback engines. A different pipeline is necessary for each satellite.

http_warning.title: HTTP sends the access token without encryption
http_warning.description: Use TLS or an isolated network. Continue only if this HTTP server is on an isolated network.

satellite.title: Satellite binding
satellite.description: Select a provisioned anonymous key for this device. Use a different key and pipeline for each device. See the setup instructions.

error.fallback_loop: An assist-live entity cannot be a fallback.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read provisioned bindings from the server.
error.invalid_url: Use an HTTP or HTTPS server URL without user information, a query, or a fragment.
error.invalid_satellite: Select a provisioned key and the pipeline selector of a satellite device.
error.binding_used: This device or key is already in use.
error.connection_limit: Use no more than five satellites for each server token.

event_stream_unavailable.title: Satellite event subscription cannot continue
event_stream_unavailable.description: The event subscription for {satellite} has repeated failures. Check the server event stream and HA storage. The integration retries with a maximum 30 s interval. It does not skip a refused event.

fallback_tts_unavailable.title: Fallback TTS entity unavailable
fallback_tts_unavailable.description: Select an available entity-backed standard TTS engine. Legacy provider names cannot supply this fallback.

server_unavailable.title: assist-live server unavailable
server_unavailable.description: Check the server URL, access token, and server status. Standard engines supply fallback speech while the server is unavailable.

shared_pipeline.title: Satellites share an assist-live pipeline
shared_pipeline.description: Select a different assist-live pipeline for each satellite. Shared pipelines cannot identify the correct satellite for each turn. See the setup instructions.
